text:
maya: heads up infra-ci blowing up on master deploys, seeing repeated failures in terraform apply step

maya: root failures look correlated with parallel matrix runs — GKE responds with quota errors when multiple nodepools try to create GPUs at once

sam: i'm also seeing the GH cache restore return 403 intermittently which forces terraform init to re-download providers and it slams the runners

juan: sample from the terraform job logs:
```
googleapi: Error 429: Quota exceeded for request, quotaExceeded
gcloud container node-pools create redwood-gpu-canary --region=us-west1 --num-nodes=1
terraform apply -auto-approve
```

li: on top of that helm upgrades sometimes time out with: `unable to recognize \"...\" in apiVersion \"somegroup/v1alpha1\"` then a retry passes

maya: my hunch: concurrent applies race on CRD/namespace creation -> helm sees partial api surface and fails to render or hit timeout

sam: short term mitigations: lower matrix parallelism, add backoff and cache restore retries, and make nodepool provisioning single-threaded

maya: current concurrency block in workflows is:
```
concurrency:
  group: infra-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
```
changing semantics might help but we don't want to cancel ongoing runs blindly

juan: suggestion: add a dedicated `nodepool-provision` job that other jobs `needs:` so we serialize GPU provisioning. also surface the nodepool output into the repo cache/artifact

owen: alternative: keep parallelism but gate only the jobs that touch cluster topology (nodepools/CRDs). others can run in parallel as usual

li: i'm opening a quick PR to rotate the GH runner IAM role for S3 access — the 403s look like stale credentials or overly narrow policies (#842)

ci-bot: workflow run 4517 started by maya on branch infra/gpu-rotation

maya: temporary workaround applied: limited matrix to 2 and bumped helm timeout to 10m; failures dropped significantly in the last 4 runs

sam: also plan to add `restore-keys` fallback and a small retry loop around the cache action in the GH workflow

juan: for helm flakiness, adding `kubectl wait --for=condition=Established crd/<name> --timeout=60s` after CRD apply fixed similar flakes in other repos

owen: i'll open a PR that: 1) introduces `nodepool-provision` gating job, 2) adds `kubectl wait` for CRDs, 3) implements cache retry/backoff

maya: thanks — if this still pops up after that we should schedule a controlled canary during low traffic to test dedicated capacity (avoid shared GPU quota)

li: ok to mark this P2 and ship the fixes today?

sam: no objections, go for it

maya: ping me on the PRs, i'll coordinate the canary if needed
